item.title: Good Morning Family - 19 November 2026
item.description:
Good morning Darcy, Spencer and Neve!
Hello everyone!
Today is Thursday, the 19 November.
Wake up everyone, it’s time to start the day.
. . . . . . . . .
Today looks like a nice calm day.
. . . . . . . . .
In Bendigo today, it will be cloudy, with a low of 16 degrees and a top of 28 degrees.
There is about a 55 percent chance of rain.
You might need a raincoat today.
. . . . . . . . .
Today’s letter is K.
Can you think of something that starts with the letter K?
. . . . . . .
